title: ActiveRunsStrip component
description:
Horizontal scrollable strip of compact run cards showing all currently active runs across all workflows. This is the first thing operators see on `/workflows`.

**File:** `dashboard/src/components/workflows/ActiveRunsStrip.tsx`

**Each card shows:**
- Workflow name (truncated to ~20 chars)
- Progress: step X/Y as a mini progress bar (thin, colored by status)
- Elapsed time since run started
- Status indicator: actively running (blue dot), waiting approval (yellow pulse), failed step (red), pending (gray)

**Behavior:**
- Uses `useActiveRuns()` hook
- Cards ordered by attention priority (hook handles sorting)
- Horizontal scroll with overflow-x-auto, snap scroll on mobile
- Click a card → navigate to `/workflows/:workflowId/runs/:runId`
- If no active runs, show a compact "All clear — no active runs" message (not a big empty state)
- Animate new cards appearing (subtle fade-in)

**Styling:** surface-card background, rounded-xl, px-4 py-3 per card, gap-3 between cards. Use RunStatusBadge variant for status indicator.
definitionOfDone: ActiveRunsStrip renders horizontal scrollable run cards
Cards show workflow name, progress bar, elapsed time, status indicator
Empty state shows compact 'All clear' message

implementationPlan.description:
Create `ActiveRunsStrip` in `dashboard/src/components/workflows/ActiveRunsStrip.tsx`.

**Data:** Uses `useActiveRuns()` hook (attention-sorted). Uses `useNavigate()` for click handler.

**Layout:** Outer div with `overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory flex gap-3 pb-2`. If loading: 4 skeleton cards (animate-pulse, w-56). If empty: compact gray text "All clear — no active runs" in a rounded pill.

**RunCard sub-component (inline, not exported):**
- `snap-start flex-shrink-0 w-56` Card with `cursor-pointer hover:shadow-lift`
- Workflow name: `text-sm font-semibold text-ink truncate max-w-[180px]` (SECURITY: text node only)
- Mini progress bar: thin 4px div, width proportional to completed/total steps. Color segments: green (succeeded), red (failed), amber (waiting), blue (running), gray (pending). Built with flex children.
- Elapsed time: computed from `run.startedAt` using `timeAgo()` helper, `text-xs text-muted`
- Status dot: 8px circle — blue (running), amber pulse (waiting), red (failed), gray (pending). Use RunStatusBadge `variant` colors.
- onClick: `navigate(`/workflows/${run.workflowId}/runs/${run.id}`)`

**Animation:** Cards use `animate-in fade-in` on mount (Tailwind animate plugin or simple opacity transition).

SECURITY: Workflow names rendered as text. No HTML injection vectors. Navigate uses template literal with IDs only (validated by router).
implementationPlan.note: Created ActiveRunsStrip with: RunCard (w-56, workflow name truncated, mini progress bar, elapsed time, status dot with pulse for approval), MiniProgressBar (1px segments colored by step status), SkeletonCard (4 cards during loading), empty state with CheckCircle2 "All clear" message. Uses useActiveRuns() for attention-sorted data. Split into ActiveRunsStripInner to avoid useNavigate in conditional render path.
